name: Mushk
overview: follows the complex lives, hidden secrets, and struggles of young adults in a feudal setting. The plot centers on Mehak (Momal Sheikh), who secretly marries Shayan (Osama Tahir), and the fierce, street-smart Guddi (Urwa Hocane) alongside Adam (Imran Ashraf), unraveling family pressures, deceit, and unexpected romance.
